preflight.scope: Availability, authentication, isolated client invocation and routing preflight only; cannot approve full profile or model/task quality.

qualification.order: Alternating engine order between pairs; finish a complete launch before starting the other engine.
qualification.variability: Retain every pair, exact task/profile outcomes and differences. Ratios/latencies are descriptive only for these finite live trials; five pairs do not establish general model-quality equivalence. Any unmatched fixture/model/rubric/client/evaluator condition prevents approval.
qualification.inherited_quality_failures: Keep absolute original evaluator acceptance statuses and failures visible. A matched baseline/candidate failure is not a fixed model-quality issue.

isolation.projects: Fresh disposable synthetic repair fixtures; original verifier files hashed before and after.
isolation.customizations: Claude --safe-mode --restricted --setting-sources '' --strict-mcp-config with an empty MCP map; no unrelated startup/MCP/tool configuration.
isolation.permissions: No tools for answer-only cases; narrowly scoped Read/Edit/Bash for the synthetic repair task, using the existing live tool's permission rules.
isolation.credentials: Existing authenticated Claude client and evaluator settings; ephemeral gateway credentials; no credentials in reports or source fixtures.
isolation.state: No production settings edits, persisted Claude session or shared temporary status ownership.

limits: This protocol covers the live language-port comparison. Local model residency/digest/cold-warm tests on 16GiB and larger systems, numerical gateway performance, supported-platform qualification and publication remain distinct requirements.
